409	#### Owned Links
410	
411	A Bead Type MAY declare that certain outgoing Link Types are **owned**:
412	each owned Link — target, pin, and properties — is part of the source
413	Bead's own versioned state. Ownership is declared per
414	(Bead Type, Link Type) pair in the owning Bead Type's descriptor —
415	`ownsOutgoing`, an object keyed by owned Link Type URL whose values are
416	`{ label?, max }` — and never on the Link Type, so the same Link Type may
417	be owned by one Bead Type and unowned by another. Nothing is owned by
418	default, only Bead Types may own, and keying by Link Type URL declares
419	each pair at most once by construction. Each declaration MUST carry
420	`max`, the largest owned set the Type permits.
421	`label` is documentation for display and SDK projection, like `name`: it
422	appears only in the Type Descriptor and MUST NOT appear in any Resource
423	record — the `ownedLinks` member is keyed by Link Type URL alone.
424	
425	`ownsOutgoing` MAY also contain the **wildcard entry** `"*"`, whose
